name: Budget
description: What your {space} spends: costs planned and paid, a target, and who owes whom.
author: Coffee Pub

provides.name: addCost
provides.label: Add it as a cost
provides.description: Add a new cost to the budget, planned or paid.

inputHints.payer: Who paid: a person's key, or their name exactly as list_members shows it. Leave out if nobody has paid.
inputHints.sharedBy: Who shares the cost: keys or names from list_members, separated by commas. Leave out for nobody.
inputHints.planned: The amount expected, above zero, in the space's own currency. No currency symbol.
inputHints.actual: The amount paid, above zero, in the space's own currency. No currency symbol.
inputHints.amount: One amount in the space's own currency: paid if payer is given, else planned.
inputHints.category: The id of a category in this budget, such as travel. Anything else counts as other.
inputHints.date: The day of the cost as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-10-14.
inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: updateCost
provides.label: Change a cost
provides.description: Change a cost in the budget, keeping what is not given.

inputHints.cost: The cost to change, as a pointer.
inputHints.amount: One amount in the space's own currency: what was paid if the cost has a payer or is paid, else what is planned.
inputHints.planned: The amount expected, above zero, in the space's own currency. Send "" to clear it.
inputHints.actual: The amount paid, above zero, in the space's own currency. Send "" to clear it.
inputHints.category: The id of a category in this budget, such as travel. Anything else counts as other.
inputHints.payer: Who paid: a person's key, or their name as list_members shows it. Send "" for nobody.
inputHints.sharedBy: Who shares the cost: keys or names from list_members, separated by commas; this replaces the list. Send "" for nobody.
inputHints.date: The day of the cost as YYYY-MM-DD. Send "" to clear it.
inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed. Send "" to clear them.

settings.label: Categories
settings.help: How costs are grouped, in this order. Other is always there and holds any cost whose category is not on the list; you can rename it but not remove it. Taking a category off the list changes no cost: it just shows under Other.
